description: This file contains a set of shell script tests for verifying the behavior of 'git reset' on an unborn branch, using a testing framework and utility functions defined in 'test-lib.sh'. It defines multiple test cases for different 'git reset' options and their expected outcomes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given label and commands.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the given output file is empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files and expects them to be identical.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output and expects a match.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies that a specific file or path does not exist.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes, typically for cleanup.
